page_title: MON 2-2 NIC | Monaco v Nice 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick. A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jonathan Clauss (Nice) but poses no threat.
90+9' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+9' Jeremie Boga (Nice) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Good work from Nice as they win a corner.

90+8' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Jordan Teze (Monaco) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed towards the right post, but it was an easy job for the goalkeeper to make a save.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Monaco.

90+6' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Yehvann Diouf sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top left corner. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Jordan Teze (Monaco) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+3' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Philipp Kohn intercepts the ball.
90+2' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
90+1' Referee Willy Delajod sees the trip by Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
89' Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
87' Jordan Teze (Monaco) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
87' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

85' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monaco are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Ansu Fati (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
80' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by George Ilenikhena (Monaco), but Yehvann Diouf is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
77' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
72' That will be all from Sofiane Diop who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Morgan Sanson (Nice).
72' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho will be replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
72' Substitution. Hicham Boudaoui makes his way off the pitch and Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) comes on as his replacement.
71' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stanis Idumbo (Monaco) comes onto the pitch for Takumi Minamino.
70' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Kassoum Ouattara is replaced by Caio Henrique (Monaco).
69' Substitution. Mika Biereth walks off the pitch and George Ilenikhena (Monaco) comes on as a substitute.

68' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
68' Jordan Teze (Monaco) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
68' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Krepin Diatta (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nice was in an offside position.
65' Jordan Teze (Monaco) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
62' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Kassoum Ouattara, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
60' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
60' Monaco quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' A cross into the box from Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is cleared. Monaco have a corner.
56' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ansu Fati (Monaco) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf no chance!
56' Ansu Fati (Monaco) is going to take the penalty!
56' Franck Haise is forced to make a change. Moise Bombito is unable to continue due to injury, Tom Louchet (Nice) comes on.
52' It doesn’t look good for Moise Bombito (Nice); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
51' Moise Bombito (Nice) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
51' Moise Bombito (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Monaco.
49' Ansu Fati (Monaco) plays a through ball but overhits it.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Adi Hutter probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mamadou Coulibaly. He is replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Yehvann Diouf gets a hand on the penalty from Ansu Fati (Monaco), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
45+5' Ansu Fati (Monaco) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+4' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Monaco!
45+3' Referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Monaco. Let’s see what happens!
45+3' Surely that's handball by one of the Nice players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45+2' Jordan Teze (Monaco) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 2 Goal! Sofiane Diop (Nice) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Philipp Kohn to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
42' Sofiane Diop (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
41' Referee Willy Delajod is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Nice!
41' Celebrations by Nice are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

40' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. PENALTY to Nice! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
38' Here is a change. Terem Moffi is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Kojo Peprah (Nice).

36' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
34' Ali Abdi (Nice) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.

32' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Sofiane Diop (Nice) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
28' A lofted cross from Ali Abdi (Nice) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
28' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' Ali Abdi (Nice) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
24' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper rises and gathers the ball.
22' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) brings his opponent down. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Monaco have been awarded a free kick.
21' Yehvann Diouf leaps to intercept the corner kick from Takumi Minamino (Monaco).
19' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
18' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Nice players look gutted.
17' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Willy Delajod is going to take a look using VAR.
17' A goal, which was scored by Antoine Mendy (Nice), was disallowed due to offside.
17' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
16' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes it short.
15' The ball is cleared after Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nice are going to take it.
14' Monaco are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
11' Terem Moffi (Nice) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
9' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
9' Ali Abdi (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Nice win a corner kick.
9' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

6' He should have scored! Terem Moffi (Nice) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
5' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
4' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Willy Delajod.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
